description: This file contains test utility classes and delegate implementations for testing the SpdyStream class in the net::test namespace. It defines various delegate classes used to simulate and verify stream behaviors during testing.

classes.name: ClosingDelegate
classes.description: A delegate that calls Close() on the associated SpdyStream when OnClose is invoked, used for testing stream closure behavior.

classes.name: StreamDelegateBase
classes.description: A base class providing shared functionality for stream delegate implementations, including handling headers, data, and stream state.

classes.name: StreamDelegateDoNothing
classes.description: A delegate that performs no actions, used for capturing stream data or state.

classes.name: StreamDelegateConsumeData
classes.description: A delegate that consumes incoming data, used for testing data reception.

classes.name: StreamDelegateSendImmediate
classes.description: A delegate that sends data immediately upon receiving headers, used for testing immediate data transmission.

classes.name: StreamDelegateWithBody
classes.description: A delegate that sends body data, used for testing data sending.

classes.name: StreamDelegateCloseOnHeaders
classes.description: A delegate that closes the stream upon receiving headers, used for testing stream closure on headers.

classes.name: StreamDelegateDetectEOF
classes.description: A delegate that detects EOF in data reception, used for testing EOF detection.
